plain_english: Under 17 February, the register records a child named George being baptised to James Glasgow, whose residence is provisionally read as Muirestoun. The witnesses include George Glasgow and John Smith; the remaining name is unresolved.
This is a baptism entry among other baptisms and marriages. It contains no testament, inventory, estate administration or death statement. The mother's name is not supplied in this entry.
findings: Target entry, lines 1-3: the source type is positively identified by both the ScotlandsPeople header and the wording 'ane bairne baptizit namit george'. It must not be catalogued as a 1605 testament merely because it was filed under testaments/Edinburgh/.

Target entry, line 2: James Glasgow is the named parent in the register's baptism formula. The witness George Glasgow is separately named and must not be substituted for the parent or assigned a grandfather relationship.
